_note: asb-baidu-1 is the interior of Istanbul Airport (İSTANBUL signage), not Ashgabat.

asb-baidu-2.webp.zh: 货运停机坪：土库曼斯坦航空的安-74 货机停在「YÜK TERMINAL」（货运航站楼）前。
asb-baidu-2.webp.en: On the cargo apron: a Turkmenistan Airlines An-74 freighter parked before the YÜK (cargo) terminal.

asb-baidu-3.webp.zh: 新建的货运航站楼外景：白色墙体配绿色檐带，一层排列着密集的装卸月台。
asb-baidu-3.webp.en: The cargo terminal building — white walls under a green fascia, a long row of loading docks at ground level.
